Aisha (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Elmbridge onboarding. Main objective: production rollout of Redwood API for in-app search-assist by 2026-05-15. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30/60/90 timeline. Quick ask: who can own integration, data mapping, and enablement?
Marco (Eng): I can own infra + test environment. Targeting test env by 2026-04-20. Will need model variant guidance and expected request qps. @Priya can you share typical enablement assets? :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions): Yep — I’ll draft the enablement checklist and runbook. I’ll include: API keys, network whitelist, sample prompts, and rollback plan. Creating a living doc now -> https://redwood.example/elmbridge-runbook (will replace with customer link).
Ben (PM): From Elmbridge side, main success metric is 20% reduction in support tickets around search queries and <=600ms median request latency. Renewal flag: if adoption <40% in first 30 days, risk moves to elevated.
Aisha (CSM): Noted. Proposed milestones: 1) Week 0-2: access & test env, sample prompts validated. 2) Week 3-6: pilot traffic (~5%): metrics baseline. 3) Week 7-12: ramp to full prod. Owners: Marco=integration, Priya=enablement, Aisha=success ops. Agree?
Marco (Eng): Agree. Quick technical risk: Elmbridge uses an on-prem proxy with sticky sessions. We need a small config tweak for KV cache eviction. I’ll post the patch snippet in the runbook:
```
# nginx proxy tweak
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_read_timeout 90s;
```
Priya (Solutions): Good call. I’ll add a troubleshooting section for sticky sessions. Also suggest one 45-min workshop for Elmbridge product + infra next Tue.
onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: Elmbridge kickoff workshop — Tue 2026-03-31 10:00-10:45 PT. Calendar invites sent.
Ben (PM): Workshop confirmed from our side. Can we include a short QA plan and 5 priority flows to validate? I’ll add them to the runbook under /validation.
Aisha (CSM): Please add the QA flows. Also capture success criteria clearly: 1) Functional parity on top 5 flows, 2) <=600ms median latency, 3) <20% error rate, 4) customer satisfaction (qualitative signoff) and 5) usage >=40% of targeted cohort.
Marco (Eng): I'll instrument metrics and push dashboards to Console > Projects > Elmbridge. Will add token-level cost estimate and expected p95.
Priya (Solutions): Plan for enablement cadence: 1x workshop, 2x office hours in pilot window, weekly status notes in this thread. I’ll also run a short post-pilot feedback survey (2 questions).
Aisha (CSM): Nice. Capturing renewal risk: high if adoption below target or latency problems persist. Mitigations: reduced model size fallback, caching tweaks, and targeted training/assist content. I’ll schedule a renewal-risk review 2 weeks before pilot end.
Ben (PM): One ask from Elmbridge leadership: can we have a lightweight playbook they can hand to Ops for support? Priya, can you produce a 1-page runbook summary? :eyes:
Priya (Solutions): Yup — summary in progress, will drop a PDF to the shared drive and link here.
Aisha (CSM): Great progress. Next actions: Marco to enable test env (ETA 2026-04-20), Priya to publish runbook draft (ETA 2026-03-28), Ben to add QA flows (ETA 2026-03-26). I’ll follow up with a 7-day checkpoint note. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
